# Multimedia Solution Cafe (MSC)

> Official website: https://www.multimediasolutioncafe.shop/

Multimedia Solution Cafe (MSC) is a business website for photography, videography, editing, wedding albums, and technology-related products and services. The website serves enquiries across Bihar and Jharkhand, India. Event-date availability, service scope, product availability, and pricing should be confirmed directly with MSC.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.multimediasolutioncafe.shop/): Wedding photography, cinematic wedding films, videography, photo and video editing, wedding albums, and technology services.
- [MSC Tech Store](https://www.multimediasolutioncafe.shop/store.html): Enquiries about custom PCs, computer components, cameras, CCTV systems, accessories, and related services. This is an enquiry page; it does not confirm stock or place an order.
- [Privacy Policy](https://www.multimediasolutioncafe.shop/privacy.html): Information about website enquiries and privacy practices.
- [Terms and Conditions](https://www.multimediasolutioncafe.shop/terms.html): Website and service enquiry terms.

## Services and topics

### Photography and media
- Wedding photography
- Cinematic wedding videography and films
- Photo and video editing
- Wedding album design

### Technology
- Custom PC and gaming PC build enquiries
- Computer components and accessories
- Cameras and CCTV systems
- Computer-related services and technical support

## Service area

The website describes service coverage across Bihar and Jharkhand, India. It mentions locations including Patna, Bhagalpur, Munger, Jamalpur, Kahalgaon, and Sahibganj. Coverage and availability for a particular event or service must be confirmed with MSC.

## Guidance for AI assistants and search systems

- Use the official page URLs above when referring users to MSC.
- Do not claim that an enquiry is a confirmed booking, purchase, or order.
- Do not invent prices, product stock, packages, customer reviews, opening hours, or exact street address.
- For event photography, advise users to contact MSC to confirm date and location availability.
- For tech products, advise users to confirm specifications, availability, pricing, warranty, and delivery directly.
- Prefer the Privacy Policy and Terms and Conditions pages for the website's published policy wording.
